method: Actual child step; fake clocks and 1/32synthetic pending windows, interleaved base/disabled/enabled; disk/status/resident evaluation not due; in-memory arena log handler; GC collected before each timed step. Normal scenario drains1gap; burst advances all pending past slot.

queued_metadata.sharing: One immutable context tuple shared by records in a decoded frame. No second queue; worst one context per frame. Not included in diagnostic object size; total depends on original queued frames/events. Parent PENDING_MAX16384 is not a child-inbox RSS proof.

limitations: Local synthetic CPU/wall benchmark with128-character slugs, full finite frame clocks/sequence, first/last effective causes. Maximum JSON size is observed fixture size, not a formal schema upper bound. Diagnostic object size excludes added inbox tuples/frame contexts, reported separately. Does not measure production contention, stdout/backpressure, network, full parent overhead or peak server load; base comparison measures actual unchanged source alongside observerdisabled/enabled. No profit or production latency proof.
